[[File:CorSec_Sword.jpg|thumb|250px|right|A CorSec sword]]
{{Quote|I've carried this blade with me since before I left my homeworld, Iskalon. Well, by the School, let it serve me well today.|Kiro|<ref name="Duel with a Dark Lady">[[Star Wars (1977) 96|''Star Wars'' (1977) 96]]</ref>}}
The '''sword''' was a bladed melee weapon widely used throughout the galaxy - even in the day of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].

==History==
[[File:Curvedsword.png|thumb|left|250px|A sword]]
The origin of the sword had been lost to antiquity. The concept of a bladed weapon with a basic hilt had been found in a huge variety of cultures, and existed in a multitude of forms. Uses included military, religious and ceremonial applications. Over the millennia, this basic weapon type had been improved and altered due to changing technologies, alloys, and even fighting styles. The result being numerous incarnations of [[short sword]]s, heavy broad swords, agile rapiers, [[double-bladed sword]]s, and even [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]] of many types which utilized an ultrasonic-vibration technology to improve cutting efficiency. The sword was doubtlessly the conceptual precursor to the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], yet both have continued to exist contemporaneously as the unique characteristics of the lightsaber preclude universal use or construction.

==Material and use==
[[File:HalfedCommandoDroid.png|thumb|right|250px|A halved [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] grips its [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]]]]
Sword variations utilized a wide range of materials, alloys, [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], minerals, even [[Bone/Legends|bone]], the goal being to produce sharper or harder blades, therefore able to do more damage and maintain their cutting edge. Powered swords, implementing vibration technology, decreased the coefficient of friction of their blades and thus were more dangerous. Many swords, particularly after the creation of the lightsaber, were designed laced with or composed of exotic materials such as [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]], or [[Obsidian/Legends|obsidian]] enabling the wielder to engage and block a lightsaber blade. Regular swords were made out of metal (such as [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], or others), plasteel, or highly bonded poly-layered ceramics.<ref name="A&E">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>

The ubiquitous existence of the sword resulted in their use by many [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] alike, even after the creation of the lightsaber. [[Ludo Kressh]] was one such Sith who used a sword as opposed to a lightsaber. Kressh's war sword was double-bladed, and, like a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], was very dangerous to use. [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] used a [[Sith sword]]. In the battles in and around [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]], swords were used as melee weapons by members of both sides of the conflict. In fact, an ancient Sith [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] severed [[Cay Qel-Droma]]'s [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arm, using a sword; towards the conclusion of the same conflict the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Freedon Nadd]] presented [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]] and [[Aleema Keto]] with two ancient [[Sith sword]]s.<ref name="The Freedon Nadd Uprising">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]''</ref> In more modern times it has generally been the Sith or Dark Jedi who have used swords. The modern Jedi considered Swords to be "barbaric" in comparison to their signature weapon, yet some Sith are known to have preferred the more visceral feel of metal cutting flesh as contrasted to a blade of energy cleanly cutting and cauterizing.

[[File:KinooineKiro.jpg|thumb|left|[[Kiro]] putting his sword to use.]]
Sith blades were often a cortosis alloy to protect them against lightsaber sparring damage. A pure cortosis blade, made of pure cortosis ore, also had the ability to cause lightsabers to short out for a small period of time on contact. The unique properties of this material in its pure and alloyed forms made it sought after, yet pure cortosis ore was a poor choice for standard swords as the blade was not very durable.

Although an ancient weapon type by the time the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rose to power, swords still saw use. The Ewoks of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used swords made from stone and other primitive weapons in their battle against the Duloks who kidnapped the Woklings from the village.<ref name="teebo">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref> Despite the proliferation of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] technology, the [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassans]] were known to use swords during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauder]] known as [[Terak]] used a sword in his dual against [[Noa Briqualon]] during the skirmish known as the [[Battle of Endor (Ewok–Sanyassan conflict)|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Ewoks: The Battle for Endor">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> [[Mustafar bandit sword]]s were another more modern variation, and other swords were used by cultures, species, assorted martial arts and combat forms, and military organizations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. For instance, after the fall of the Galactic Empire, [[Kiro]], a [[Chuhkyvi]] who served the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War|Nagai crisis]], used a sword from [[Iskalon/Legends|his homeworld]] during the [[Skirmish on Kinooine]] to dispose of several [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] soldiers.<ref name="Duel with a Dark Lady" /><ref name="Escape">[[Star Wars (1977) 97|''Star Wars'' (1977) 97]]</ref>
